summarize_dataset_info: summarize the halpe26 dataset_info dictionary containing 26 body keypoints and 27 skeleton links for full-body pose estimation
review_keypoint_info: review the 26 keypoint definitions including nose, eyes, ears, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles, toes, and heels
review_skeleton_info: review the 27 skeleton links that connect keypoints to form the full-body pose skeleton structure
review_joint_weights: review the joint_weights array used to weight each of the 26 keypoints during pose estimation training
review_sigmas: review the sigmas array containing PCK evaluation tolerance values for each of the 26 keypoints
